controles.affirmation: Le S-4/A previent que « The combined company may be unable to successfully integrate the businesses of Equity Residential and AvalonBay and realize the anticipated benefits of the merger », page 49 ; et cite separement un risque de perte de personnel de direction.
controles.verbatim_source: S-4/A du 09/07/2026 (VMRK_2026-07-09_S4A.htm.gz), section Risks Relating to the Combined Company : "The combined company may be unable to successfully integrate the businesses of Equity Residential and AvalonBay and realize the anticipated benefits of the merger." Ce titre est situe entre les marqueurs de page 48 et 49 : la page 49 est correcte. Second risque : "Uncertainties associated with the merger may cause a loss of management personnel and other key employees, and Equity Residential and AvalonBay may have difficulty attracting and motivating management personnel and other key employees, which could adversely affect the future business and operations of the combined company."

controles.affirmation: Environ 750 M$ de couts de transaction et d'integration estimes, aucune synergie chiffree en contrepartie ; CA combine pro forma 6 135,9 M$ sur l'exercice 2025.
controles.verbatim_source: S-4/A, Unaudited Pro Forma, Note 1 : "The estimated transaction and integration costs for both AvalonBay and Equity Residential are expected to be approximately $750.0 million in the aggregate" ; "The unaudited pro forma financial statements do not reflect: (i) non-executive employee severance... (iii) any cost savings or operating synergies that the combined company may realize following the merger or the costs necessary to achieve such synergies or (iv) any dis-synergies that may result from the merger." ; Total revenue pro forma $6,135,933 k.

controles.affirmation: Les 750 M$ representent pres de 1,5 fois le resultat net combine pro forma part actionnaires de l'exercice 2025 (515,9 M$).
controles.verbatim_source: Le chiffre est exact : S-4/A, "Net income attributable to common shareholders... $515,944" (colonne Pro forma, exercice 2025). Mais la comparaison est circulaire : la Note 1 precise que "The expensed transaction, development, and other costs adjustment of $750.0 million for the year ended December 31, 2025 is for estimated transaction costs in connection with the merger". Les 750 M$ sont deja deduits du resultat pro forma de 515,9 M$ : comparer le cout au resultat qu'il a lui-meme ampute gonfle mecaniquement le ratio.
controles.correction_proposee: Comparer les 750 M$ au resultat net combine AVANT ajustement de fusion (1 051,3 M$ + 1 118,7 M$ selon les colonnes historiques du pro forma), ou au CA pro forma de 6 135,9 M$ (12 %), et signaler explicitement que le 515,9 M$ est deja net de ces couts.

controles.affirmation: Ratio d'echange fixe de 2,793 actions Equity Residential pour 1 action AvalonBay, valeur implicite de 185,12 $ par action au 20 mai 2026 (cours EQR de 66,28 $), sans ajustement pour les variations de cours.
controles.verbatim_source: S-4/A : "will be converted into the right to receive 2.793 (the “exchange ratio”) common shares of beneficial interest" ; "The exchange ratio in the merger is fixed and will not be adjusted for changes in the market value of AvalonBay common stock or Equity Residential common shares... Based on the closing price of Equity Residential common shares on the NYSE of $66.28 on May 20, 2026, the last trading day before public announcement of the transactions". Calcul verifie : 66,28 x 2,793 = 185,12 $.
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance : le S-4/A precise "except for customary adjustments in the event of certain changes in Equity Residential's or AvalonBay's capitalization or the payment of certain distributions". L'ATT ecrit « sans ajustement », a nuancer en « sans ajustement pour les variations de cours ».

controles.affirmation: Au 30 juin 2026, AvalonBay portait 9 079,1 M$ de principal de dette a un taux moyen de 3,7 %, Equity Residential 8 261,7 M$ de « dette nette » a 3,72 % et 3,77 % selon les tranches, soit environ 17,3 Mds$ combines.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q AvalonBay T2 2026 : "Total principal outstanding 9,079,099" au taux 3,7 %. 10-Q Equity Residential T2 2026 : "Total debt, net $8,261,669" ; "Weighted Average Interest Rate 3.72 %" (mortgages) et "3.77 %" (notes). Somme : 17 340,8 M$.
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance de traduction importante : "Total debt, net" chez EQR signifie dette totale nette des frais d'emission, PAS dette nette de la tresorerie. Traduire par « dette nette » induit un investisseur francophone en erreur. Ecrire « 8 261,7 M$ de dette totale (nette des frais d'emission) ». Egalement, on additionne un principal (AVB) et une valeur comptable nette (EQR) : bases legerement heterogenes.

controles.affirmation: Le S-4/A ne signale aucune degradation du ratio d'endettement par rapport aux deux entites separees, « autour de 4,3 a 4,6 fois l'EBITDAre chez chacune » ; 4,6x chez AvalonBay et 4,28x chez Equity Residential « selon les KPI publies au T1 2026 ».
controles.verbatim_source: Aucun ratio dette nette / EBITDAre ne figure dans les deux 10-Q cites : 0 occurrence de "EBITDAre" dans VMRK_2026-07-30_AVB.htm.gz et dans VMRK_2026-07-30_EQR.htm.gz. Le S-4/A contient des projections de Normalized EBITDAre mais aucun ratio de levier de 4,3x a 4,6x. Les valeurs 4,6x et 4,28x proviennent uniquement de .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/VMRK.json (KPI AVB_net_debt_ebitdare et EQR_net_debt_ebitdare), dont le last_data_date est 2026-06-30, soit le T2 2026 et non le T1 2026 comme l'affirme l'ATT.
controles.correction_proposee: Soit sourcer ces ratios sur les supplemental packages trimestriels des deux societes et les archiver, soit retirer l'affirmation « le S-4/A ne signale aucune degradation du ratio ». Corriger en tout etat de cause « au T1 2026 » en « au 30 juin 2026 ».

controles.affirmation: Conseil de 14 membres, 7 d'Equity Residential et 7 d'AvalonBay, preside par Stephen Sterrett ; comites permanents composes a parts egales et presidences divisees a parts egales ; le S-4/A reconnait que le changement de composition « may affect the strategy of the combined company ».
controles.verbatim_source: 8-K/ER du 17/08/2026 : "Vivmark's Board of Trustees consists of 14 trustees, seven from each company, and is led by Stephen Sterrett as Chairman." S-4/A : "the board of trustees of the combined company will have fourteen (14) members, consisting of (i) seven (7) members of the Equity Residential board... and (ii) seven (7) members of the AvalonBay board" ; "The standing committees of the combined company board will be comprised initially of equal numbers of trustees who served on the Equity Residential board prior to the effective time and directors who served on the AvalonBay board prior to the effective time, and the chairs of such standing committees will be divided equally" ; "The merger will result in changes to the Equity Residential board that may affect the strategy of the combined company as compared to that of Equity Residential and AvalonBay independently."

controles.affirmation: Dividende annualise initial de 2,81 $ par action, equivalent a l'ancien dividende Equity Residential et superieur au rendement AvalonBay, soumis a la discretion du conseil qui se reserve le droit de changer la politique a tout moment.
controles.verbatim_source: S-4/A : "the combined company is expected to pay an initial annualized dividend of $2.81 per common share, which is equivalent to Equity Residential's existing dividend per share and higher than AvalonBay's current dividend yield, subject to the discretion of the combined company board, which reserves the right to change the combined company's dividend policy at any time and for any reason."

controles.affirmation: Risque de regulation des loyers cite pour les deux portefeuilles et repris pour le groupe combine.
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q AvalonBay T2 2026 : "new or existing laws and regulations implementing rent control or rent stabilization, or otherwise limiting our ability to increase rents, charge non-rent fees or evict tenants, may impact our revenue or increase our costs". S-4/A : "expansion of rent control, rent stabilization, eviction moratoriums or other regulations that restrict the methods and strategies of the combined company's business".

controles.affirmation: Plus de 99 % des votes exprimes aux deux assemblees du 12 aout 2026 ont approuve la fusion, chacune representant environ 90 % du capital en circulation ; le communique de cloture cite toujours un risque de litige lie a la fusion.
controles.verbatim_source: Communique du 12/08/2026 : "More than 99% of the votes cast at the AvalonBay special meeting voted to approve the merger, which represented approximately 90% of the outstanding shares of AvalonBay common stock, as of the record date, and more than 99% of the votes cast at Equity Residential's special meeting voted to approve the issuance... which represented approximately 90% of the outstanding Equity Residential common shares". Communique du 17/08/2026 : "potential litigation relating to the Merger that could be instituted against Vivmark or its trustees, managers or officers, including resulting expense and the effects of any outcomes related thereto".

controles.affirmation: Le S-4/A previent que le groupe combine pourrait subir des consequences fiscales defavorables si l'une des deux societes a echoue ou echoue a se qualifier comme REIT (page 53).
controles.verbatim_source: S-4/A : "The combined company may incur adverse tax consequences if Equity Residential or AvalonBay has failed or fails to qualify as a REIT for U.S. federal income tax purposes." Ce titre se situe entre les marqueurs de page 52 et 53 : la page 53 est correcte.

controles.affirmation: Capitalisation boursiere d'environ 51 Mds$, valeur d'entreprise d'environ 70 Mds$ au 17 aout 2026 ; plus de 184 000 appartements ; pipeline de developpement de 4,2 Mds$.
controles.verbatim_source: Communique de cloture du 17/08/2026 : "an equity market capitalization of approximately $51 billion and an enterprise value of approximately $70 billion, with more than 184,000 rental apartments and over 11,100 apartments under construction" ; "Vivmark also has an approximately $4.2 billion development rights pipeline representing approximately 9,900 future" logements.

controles.affirmation: Croissance des revenus same-store « au dernier trimestre publie avant fusion » : +2,2 % pour l'ex-Equity Residential, +1,6 % pour l'ex-AvalonBay.
controles.verbatim_source: Les deux chiffres ne portent pas sur la meme periode. AvalonBay : 10-Q T2 2026, "The 1.0% increase in Same Store Residential NOI for the three months ended June 30, 2026 is due to an increase in Residential revenue of $10,958,000, or 1.6%" — chiffre TRIMESTRIEL. Equity Residential : le 2,2 % est le total du tableau "Same Store Residential Results/Statistics by Market" intitule "June YTD 2026 vs. June YTD 2025", portant sur 78 385 logements sur SIX MOIS — chiffre SEMESTRIEL, pas trimestriel. Le fichier KPI le date en outre 2026-03-31, ce qui est une troisieme periode encore differente.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire : « +1,6 % pour l'ex-AvalonBay sur le T2 2026 et +2,2 % pour l'ex-Equity Residential sur le premier semestre 2026 » et supprimer « au dernier trimestre publie » qui laisse croire a deux chiffres homogenes.
